name: Are comfort height toilets ADA compliant?

mainEntity.name: Are comfort height toilets ADA compliant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many comfort height toilets are designed to meet ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) guidelines for toilet height, which specifies a seat height of 17 to 19 inches from the floor. However, ADA compliance involves more than just toilet height; it also considers clear floor space, grab bar placement, and faucet accessibility. While a comfort height toilet is a key component, achieving full ADA compliance for a bathroom requires a comprehensive assessment of the entire space. We can help guide you through these requirements.
